description:
Send an image, video, or audio attachment as a direct message.

The URL must be public HTTPS; Meta fetches it server-side. The same 24-hour window applies as for text messages.

account_id.description: Sending account ID; omit for the token's own

media_type.description: Attachment type Meta should treat the URL as

media_url.description: Public HTTPS URL of the file to send

recipient_id.description: Instagram-scoped user ID (IGSID) of the recipient. Get it from instagram_list_conversations participants or from a messaging webhook — a public @username will not work.

name: instagram_send_media_message
title: Send Media Message
